The '''Urkupp system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Urkupp]].
